newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan guru says wants to study radioactivity in US.
newsitem.headline: Japan guru says wants to study radioactivity in US.

text.p: The doomsday cult guru on trial for masterminding the nerve gas attack on the Tokyo subway said on Thursday that he wants to go to the United States.
"I want to go to America to study radioactivity," Shoko Asahara said in English after the chief judge ordered him to stop disrupting proceedings.
The 42-year-old Asahara, whose real name is Chizuo Matsumoto, repeatedly interrupted Thursday's hearing by suddenly standing up and mumbling.
He has been removed from court several times for making incomprehensible statements.
Asahara, leader of the Aum Shinri Kyo (Supreme Truth Sect), is being tried on a total of 16 counts, including murder.
He stands accused of masterminding the March 20, 1995, gas attack, which killed 12 people and made 6,000 others ill.
If he is found guilty of the murder charges he faces a mandatory death sentence by hanging.
